name: work_emi_team_manager
description: The work team: a group of agents that carries out a piece of work end to end and reports what it actually did. Give it the whole goal in detail — it plans its own steps, uses the tools it needs, and writes its findings back as it goes. Use it for anything that DOES work: research, drafting, gathering, checking, creating a record, sending something through a channel. Anything whose point is to reach the user and wait for their answer is a question, not work.

inputs.name: information
inputs.description: supporting context (names, dates, prior results) or ''

inputs.name: work_id
inputs.description: When the caller has already claimed a work-object node for this call, its work object id. The team then runs ON that node instead of as a one-shot.

inputs.name: node_id
inputs.description: The claimed node's id, paired with work_id.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments to this tool are:
arguments: task, information

task: str — the whole goal, in detail and in the caller's own words. The team plans its own steps, so do not decompose it; do not change its meaning. Copy the wording verbatim where you can.
information: str — supporting context the team would otherwise have to rediscover (names, dates, identifiers, results already gathered), or ''.
